data.name: Matin
data.gender_notes: Matin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who comes before others, the one who is early, the one who brings light to others. The name Matin carries the meaning “Early” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Matin usually hope their child will grow to embody early and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) in Arabic, symbolizing the dawn of light and the beginning of a new era
data.etymology: Matin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Early.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Matin total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: مَتين
in_arabic.long_meaning: مَتين من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني القوي الحصين الذي لا يمكن هزيمته، وهو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، مثل قوله تعالى: «وَمَتِينٌ فِي عَزْمِ الرِجَالِ» (الحديد: 25)، ويعني أيضًا الثابت الذي لا يتزعزع

in_urdu.name: متین
in_urdu.meaning: خدا کا نام، قوی، مضبوط، عزت والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: متین اللہ تعالیٰ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جو قوی اور مضبوط کے معنی میں ہے، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں بھی آیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ آل عمران میں: «وَيُمَتِينَ عَزْمَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا» (آل عمران: 103)، اور یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں بہت استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: मतीन
in_hindi.meaning: अल्लाह का नाम, शक्तिशाली, मजबूत, सम्मानित
in_hindi.long_meaning: मतीन अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है शक्तिशाली और मजबूत, यह नाम कुरआन में भी आया है, जैसे कि सूरह आলে इमरान में: «وَيُمَتِينَ عَزْمَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا» (आल इमरान: 103), और यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत प्रयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: متین
in_pashto.meaning: الله تعالیٰ پښتو، قوي، مضبوط، ویاړلی
in_pashto.long_meaning: متین د الله تعالیٰ ښکلي نومونو څخه یو دی، چی معنی یی قوي او مضبوط وي، دا نوم په قرآن کریم کی هم راغلی دی، لکه څنګه چی په سوره آل عمران کی: «وَيُمَتِينَ عَزْمَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا» (آل عمران: 103)، او دا نوم په افغان او پښتني دود کی ډیر استعمال کیږي

in_english.name: Matin
in_english.meaning: One of God's beautiful names, powerful, strong, and mighty
in_english.long_meaning: Matin is one of the beautiful names of God in Islam, meaning powerful, strong, and mighty. It is derived from the Arabic root 'M-T-N' which signifies strength and resilience. The name Matin is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Imran (3:103), and has been used throughout Islamic history to describe God's attributes. In Islamic tradition, the name Matin symbolizes spiritual strength and courage.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: متین

data.cultural_impact: The name Matin can be considered as a symbol of leadership and responsibility in the Islamic community. The name 'Matin' is derived from the Arabic word for 'dawn', representing the idea of being the first to rise and lead others through hardships, struggles, and days ahead. This name was common among early Muslims who were the first to accept the religion, spread it, and implement its teachings. It also symbolizes determination, loyalty, and selflessness, making it an ideal name for children in Muslim families.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Matin represents a deep inner strength and commitment to one's faith. It implies that the person bearing the name is a guiding light, not just for their community, but for themselves as well. The name reminds us of the importance of being steadfast in our beliefs, kind to those around us, and sincere in our actions. The spiritual significance of the name Matin lies in the reminder of the Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) statement, "The best among you is the one who is most beneficial to others." Thus, it inspires individuals to strive towards being a positive influence in their communities while staying connected to their spiritual roots.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Early" symbolizes The one who comes before others, the one who is early, the one who brings light to others.
